known_exceptions.reason: AARS v0.1 is a published third-party-authored paper (Neo.K / EveMissLab) predating the 2026-08-15 AICL-I v0.2 naming disambiguation. Its own text is frozen at v0.1 publication and is not this integration's content to silently rewrite; a future AARS patch document would need to address this, the same way the v0.1.1 patches did for AIRS/AILP/AICR/AICL.

The literal JSON field value "protocol": "AICL" matches this site's actual, unchanged protocol identifier (id: 'aicl' in protocols.ts) -- renaming it to "AICL-C" here would make the example inconsistent with every other AICL reference on the site. The AICL-I v0.2 paper itself says human-facing prose MAY use the bare form where context is unambiguous (a policy-example "catalog" titled after a licensing schema is such a context).

note: Scans src/content/whitepapers/*.md and src/data/*.ts for bare "AICL" without a -C/-I suffix or nearby disambiguation hint (AICL-C, AICL-I, "Content Licensing", "Ingestion", or the corresponding Chinese terms).
